report_name: Mid Sussex District Council Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify latent demand for cycle and school commuting, model future cycling flows under the 'E-Bike' and 'Go Dutch' scenarios, and inform the development of the cycle network by identifying key desire lines.
other_tools_developed: Route Selection Tool (RST) and Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP identifies a pipeline of investment and prioritised infrastructure improvements to support active travel, though it is noted that the plan is not designed to create 'shovel-ready' proposals and will require further design work if delivery funding is secured.
pct_usage_quote: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (www.pct.bike) is a nationwide model that identifies where increases in the rates of cycling can be expected through the provision of better infrastructure.
